title: Function Theory 5.60: Hadamard convolution lowering
strongest_result: The target holds for polynomial phi of degree N <= 2 alpha; the known integer-alpha case is reconstructed for arbitrary analytic phi. Any counterexample admits a robust polynomial representative with rational alpha,beta and Gaussian-rational coefficients.
remaining_gap: Noninteger alpha > 1, beta >= 1 and polynomials of unbounded degree N > 2 alpha. No proof or valid counterexample established.
compute_scope: 208 exact finite algebra checks; 1152 polynomial heuristic samples on a 96-angle grid, ten selected cases refined to 4096 angles. No continuum zero-free certification or exhaustive search.
